# Test fixtures

These are small, curated fixtures made for automated tests and local visual
checks. The sailing date, itinerary, watch target, and catalog selection are
demonstration data. They are not exports from a deployed App, a cruise
reservation, or the App-private `/data` volume.

Keep fixtures limited to public-style catalog fields and invented preferences.
Never copy live catalogs, watch targets, notification data, tokens, or SQLite
history into this directory.
